note: Card scheme artwork for the payment page. Show only the schemes enabled for the online channel by the connected PSPs. Use the id as the key.

box.note: Same framed chip for every scheme. Artwork widths are fitted inside it. Cartes Bancaires is scaled like the others by Halba's decision (below its charte minimum).

maestro.name: Maestro
maestro.note: Symbol only (two circles, from the horizontal positive lockup, wordmark removed). Not checked against Mastercard brand rules for symbol-only use.

diners.name: Diners Club
diners.note: Disc symbol only, from the colour EPS (converted to SVG, wordmark removed). The black EPS was received and is not used. Not checked against Diners Club International brand rules.

orderNote: Fixed order, set by Halba: Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, Cartes Bancaires, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, JCB, UnionPay (Maestro follows Mastercard, Diners Club follows Discover, same groups). A scheme that is not enabled is skipped and the next one takes its place. Departs from the alphabetical order that the Cartes Bancaires charte asks for.
